copy.header: The highest-IV names already tied to a dated catalyst in the next few weeks. The score is how much richer that date is than the ones around it. High IV is never itself a catalyst.
copy.subhead: Ticker-owned events only, ranked by implied volatility.
copy.footer: Macro days — CPI, FOMC, payrolls — are skipped. They light up the whole tape and tell you nothing about one name.
